text: The caravan traders didn't have a chance. They're all dead.
source_text: The caravan traders didn't have a chance. They're all dead.

text: 那些商队的成员全都死了，无一幸免。
source_text: 那些商队的成员全都死了，无一幸免。

text: It looks like the mutants were heavily armed. The caravan traders# didn't have a chance against this kind of firepower.
source_text:
It looks like the mutants were heavily armed. The caravan traders
# didn't have a chance against this kind of firepower.

text: 看起来那些变种人装备精良。商队的成员根本没有机会和这种程度的火力对抗。
source_text: 看起来那些变种人装备精良。商队的成员根本没有机会和这种程度的火力对抗。

text: You're pretty sure it's a dead person.
source_text: You're pretty sure it's a dead person.

text: 你可以肯定这是一具尸体。
source_text: 你可以肯定这是一具尸体。

text: Through all the mutated flesh and muscle one of them looks familiar.# It's one of the scouts that was sent out by the Vault that never returned...

Through all the mutated flesh and muscle one of them looks familiar.

text: 在一堆变种人的尸骨和肌肉组织中有一具看起来似乎很熟悉。它属于被避难所派出去但从未返回的侦察员之一……
source_text: 在一堆变种人的尸骨和肌肉组织中有一具看起来似乎很熟悉。它属于被避难所派出去但从未返回的侦察员之一……

text: Through all the mutated flesh and muscle you somehow recognize one of# the mutants to be Sean, one of the scouts sent out by your Vault a few months# before you left.
source_text:
Through all the mutated flesh and muscle you somehow recognize one of

# before you left.

text: 在一堆变种人的尸骨和碎肉中，不知何故你认出了其中一具尸体是肖恩，在你之前几个月被派出避难所派的侦察员。
source_text: 在一堆变种人的尸骨和碎肉中，不知何故你认出了其中一具尸体是肖恩，在你之前几个月被派出避难所派的侦察员。

text: All the mutants are dead, but one looks strangely familiar, but you# can't place the 'face'.

All the mutants are dead, but one looks strangely familiar, but you

text: 所有的变种人都死了，其中一具尸体看起来不可思议的熟悉，但你却无法将它和任何记忆中的“面孔”联系起来。
source_text: 所有的变种人都死了，其中一具尸体看起来不可思议的熟悉，但你却无法将它和任何记忆中的“面孔”联系起来。
